notes.title: Version 1.01 and Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Long time no see.

We just pushed out version 1.01. You will find the main menu music is now at a much more appropriate decibel level. While Minerva is a fantastic producer, we also respect and value our headphone users' hearing.

Spire has received some updates - the cloud level towards the bottom of the map is a bit easier to navigate now with fewer gaps to fall to your death. Jump pack still highly recommended, but hopefully this change helps the flow of the map!

Most importantly...Steam just released Remote Play Together for everybody! Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/together

This is fantastic - if just one of your friends owns a copy of Engineer Arena, you can now all play it as if you were sitting right next to each other! We hope you'll give this new feature a shot.

As always, reach out to us @EngineerArena on Twitter with any questions, comments, or OP kbm rifle kills. Remember: friends don't let friends play with rifle on kbm against controller users.
